risk.explanation: Preliminary static-analysis indicator score. It is not a calibrated malware probability. A low score does not establish that a package is safe.

limitations: Only Python source files are analyzed.
Taint analysis is sequential and intraprocedural.
Complex control-flow propagation is not implemented.
Cross-function taint propagation is not implemented.
Package metadata and README claims are not analyzed yet.
Previous-version comparison is not implemented yet.
No dynamic sandbox execution has been performed.

stage_1_name_and_lie_detector.summary: Package identity and README comparison are pending.

stage_2_password_and_gibberish_tracker.summary: AST behaviour indicators and basic source-to-sink taint analysis performed.

stage_3_update_hijack_detector.summary: Previous package version was not supplied.

stage_4_fake_bait_sandbox.summary: Isolated sandbox is not implemented yet.

stage_5_false_alarm_filter.summary: Evidence correlation is not implemented yet.

stage_6_ai_reporter.summary: AI-assisted reporting is not implemented yet.
